highlights: Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) and Deputy DSL
Strict Safe Recruitment and Criminal Background Checks
Lanyard Colour-Coding System for Visitors and Staff
safety.policy_summary: The school enforces a comprehensive child safeguarding and visitor management policy. This includes mandatory staff training and background checks, criminal record verification, a visitor ID and lanyard colour-coding system (Blue for staff, Green for cleared visitors, and Red for visitors requiring supervision), and active monitoring by the Designated Safeguarding Lead.
